summary: Discordian Bastion is the Muramite command fortress of the War-Shade Expanse. Here, commanders drill their armies, War-Shades are shaped into elite soldiers, and Discord-forged machinery pulses through the walls.
history: Muramite warlords constructed the Bastion as their primary command center.
War-Shades were trained here to serve as elite shock troops.
Discord-forged machinery was integrated into the fortress walls.
The Discordian Warlord rose to power, commanding both Muramites and War-Shades.
